summary: Tubten Nyima studied under Jamyang Khyentse Chökyi Lodrö and Dodrupchen Rinpoche.
Tubten Tsondru studied under Dilgo Khyentse, Dodrupchen Rinpoche, Khunu Lama Tenzin Gyaltsen, and Khenpo Gangshar. He taught Khenchen Palden Sherab Rinpoche and Ringu Tulku.
Tukaram Ramchandra Laddu was an Indologist and linguist who studied at the University of Halle until 1912. He held an attested post at Sampurnanand Sanskrit University in 1920.
Tulku Hungkar Dorje studied under Penor Rinpoche and Dodrupchen Rinpoche.
Working in Buddhist studies and Tibetology, Tulku Sherdor studied at Vassar College, Naropa University, and the University of Virginia. He studied under Jeffrey Hopkins and Tulku Urgyen Rinpoche.

Tulku Thondup worked in Tibetology and Buddhist studies. He studied at Dodrupchen Monastery under Kyala Khenpo, Khenpo Chemchok, and Dodrupchen Rinpoche, and served as a visiting scholar at Harvard University.

Tulku Urgyen Rinpoche worked in Buddhist studies and Tibetology, studying under Samten Gyatso, Dilgo Khyentse, Jamyang Khyentse Chökyi Lodrö, Karsé Kongtrul, and Rangjung Rigpe Dorje. He founded Tergar Osel Ling Monastery and taught numerous disciples.

Turrell V. Wylie specialized in Tibetology, Sinology, and linguistics, earning a B.A. from the University of Washington, which he founded. He studied under Giuseppe Tucci and Dezhung Rinpoche, later serving as professor at the University of Washington.
Tutob Chökyi Wangchuk studied under Dilgo Khyentse, Tulku Urgyen Rinpoche, Rangjung Rigpe Dorje, and Trulshik Rinpoche.
Tuyet Tam Thi Pham is a Buddhist studies scholar who earned an MA at Mahachulalongkornrajavidyalaya University, where she studied under Somboon Vuddhikaro and Sanu Mahatthanadull.
Tyler Dewar works in Tibetology and Buddhist studies. He studied at the Nitartha Institute and under traditional teachers Dzogchen Ponlop Rinpoche and Acharya Tashi Wangchuk.

A Buddhist studies scholar, Tzung-Kuen Wen earned a PhD at the University of Queensland under Primož Pecenko, Tamara Ditrich, and Chris Kang. He also studied under Yang-zhu Xu, Nandasiri Sayadaw, and Sayadaw U Pandita, and lectured at Fuyan Buddhist Institute.

U Ba Khin worked in Buddhist studies and religious studies, studying under Saya Thetgyi. He founded the International Meditation Centre and taught disciples including Satya Narayan Goenka and Mother Sayamagyi.
Ugyen Pelgen works in Tibetology and history/archaeology. He earned a master's degree from Aligarh Muslim University and served as a lecturer of history at Sherubtse College.
Ulrich Pagel works in Tibetology, Buddhist studies, and Indology. He studied under Tadeusz Skorupski, Philip T. Denwood, and Renate Söhnen-Thieme, and held a post at SOAS University of London.

Ulrich Timme Kragh works in Buddhist studies, Tibetology, and Indology, having studied at the Karmapa International Buddhist Institute and the University of Copenhagen. He held academic posts at Copenhagen, Geumgang University, Harvard, IIAS, the University of Sydney, and ANU.

Linguist and historian Ulrich von Wilamowitz-Moellendorff studied at Bonn and Berlin under Johannes Schmidt, Otto Jahn, and Moriz Haupt. He held professorships at the universities of Greifswald, Göttingen, and Berlin.

Ulrike Roesler is a scholar of Tibetology, Indology, and Buddhist studies who earned a PhD at the University of Münster. She taught at the universities of Marburg and Freiburg, and became Professor of Tibetan and Himalayan Studies at Oxford.

Uma Chakravarti works in history, Indology, and Buddhist studies. She studied at Banaras Hindu University, Miranda House, and the University of Delhi under D. Devahuti, and was an educator at Miranda House from 1966 to 1998.
Umakant Premanand Shah worked in Indology and history/archaeology. He was appointed deputy director of the Oriental Institute, Vadodara, in 1954, and became head of its Ramayana Project in 1965.
